hotel_name: Lime Tree Hotel Pulkit Gurgaon Artemis Hospital, Nearest Millennium City Centre Metro Station

positive_snippets:
I had a wonderful stay at Lime Tree Hotel. The service was excellent and impressively fast, making the entire experience very smooth and comfortable. The location is convenient, and the rooms were clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable.

The staff were extremely professional and attentive, always ready to assist with a smile. The food at the hotel was delicious, with a variety of options that catered to different tastes.

I would like to especially appreciate the warm and courteous hospitality of the manager, Mr. Harish, who made our stay even more pleasant with his kind and professional manner.

Overall, Lime Tree Hotel exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.
